2026-10-30. Hypothesis: if HASH160 the central key point coincides with the purpose first p New keys near the center are more successful than new uniform keys. Checked out p=8/12 bits radii R=16/4096/16777216. This is a limited pilot non-replication 8–14 hexadecimal solver. Complete puzzle-keys are not mixed with hypothetical values before masking: This is where the scalar is directly used k into [2^70,2^71).

Samples and immutable rules

  • 32 independent new synthetic targets seed objectives are maintained in vault; The selection of candidates will only receive HASH160, Not targeted private keys.
  • 32768 of fresh, uniform centers on the target, all 1048576=2^20. The keys are coming out from SHAKE256 randomly preserved 256-bitten seed and the division of domains; flatly 70 random minor bits, most significant bit 70 set.
  • From the matching centers, evenly choose the maximum 24 for p=8 and 8 for p=12 on target. One center can fall into both groups; this is accounted for by target clustering. If there are fewer coincidences, take everything, do not pick up new centers.
  • For each selected centre: 16 new neighbors R=16, 120 upon R=4096 and 120 upon R=2^24; The displacements are uniform among the permissible non-zero offsets maximum 1024*256=262144 Against each, one new uniform control from the same range. Selection and permutation use fixed seed, derived master seed; saved versions NumPy.
  • All centers are generated to the neighbors. Globally eliminated already viewed keys, centers, control keys and repeats between targets/thresholds/radii. Boundaries are taken into account by discarding the candidate, without wrapping or pinching At the end of the neighborhood, maintain the actual size And the same amount of control; it's a separate event, not a zero outcome.
  • All scalars are preserved HASH160, selected centers, membership of groups, Exception counters 128 Fixed centers are independent Python calculus secp256k1. Existing samples of the experiment B not used.

Metrics and statistics

The two main metrics for each pair p,R: first-time p bit-and-match The next eight bits that didn't participate in the selection 12 one-way tests advantages of neighbours, Holm, family alpha=0.01. Joint coincidence p+8 bit full-fledged HASH160 They are considered descriptively; there are no additional tests for them.

A unit of independence is a whole goal with all centers, thresholds and radii. The pair comparison, the number of neighbors and the control in each block is the same two shoulders inside the target (65535 accidental sign permutations; p corrected (b+1)/(B+1)), Same signs for everyone 12 This is a zero exchange test It does not imply the independence of individual neighbours.

Cluster pairs bootstrap posture 32 objectives: 65536 repetitions, intervals of difference frequency95% and Bonferroni 99% simultaneously 12 It's an approximate metric intervals; when total <20 success, <8 informational purposes or degenerate The distribution clearly labels the unreliability of rare events It is useful to exclude small effects from bootstrap. Maintaining the conservative border Hoeffding independently and power reference with perfect independence of hashes (80%, alpha/12). Relative effect to show as a neighbor/control and as a difference/p0, p0=2^(-p) for prefix and 1/256 for the next bits. The zero denominator is not Replace the random pseudofrequency.

Controls prior to the main run

  1. cryptographic vector k=1, boundary of the range, equivalence of extraction Binary string bits, exact values Holm, zero-point/positive/reverse Statistical controls; check for the removal of repeats and small neighborhood boundaries.
  2. Positive control of the whole conveyor: function SHA256(domain || BE(k>>30))[:20], block-bound 2^30. 32 targets 8192 centre/purpose, limits of centres 4/2, posture 8/16/16 All six prefix tests must pass Holm 0.01. The following: 8 The bits are not required to show the signal; their result is saved.
  3. Eight independent negative runs: SHA256(domain || BE(k))[:20] how a pseudorandom oracle without the proximity of adjacent entrances, 32 targets 4096 centres/target other reduced parameters as above >1 family-false Stop the main experience by triggering it. Save all the triggers. 8 runaway not count as accurate level validation 1%.
  4. Staff stop after checks, resume without repeating them, the final resume with zero new tasks and an independent audit of the non-intersection of saved scalars.

Budget, report and continuation

Do 900 seconds CPU wall time The main cycle with controls, without writing code. Check between stages; stage - one control run or one goal, not It's a hard interruption in the middle of the stage, and it's left unfinished. For every stage JSON + NPZ (where data is needed), SHA-256, time, checkpoint and renewed RESULTS.md; interpretations are written in NOTES.md. Entrance and code Frozen, their change requires a new ID. The report is reassembled without computation.

Repeat the unaltered protocol with a new signal seed and new goals, if the balance of the budget allows (orientation at least) 180 No replication Even the confirmed effect of the short prefix is not extrapolated 160 Take into account the search for centers and the full number of unique hashings; working order of search No71 You can't change the result of the pilot.
